Synopsis:
BOJ hawkish board member Hajime Takata signals the BOJ should hike rates nimbly and flexibly rather than follow a fixed semiannual pace. He flags intensifying inflation pressures in Japan (partly Middle East-linked), rising global yields (Japan 10Y at 3%), and warns FX volatility could result from policy divergence between Japan and overseas central banks. Sources indicate a potential BOJ hike as soon as September 18, with more aggressive hiking considered thereafter.
